title: AI in Aviation: Transforming Safety and Sustainability
description: AI is used in aviation for predictive maintenance, air traffic support, fuel planning, safety monitoring, and the decisions where failure is not a charming option.
short_description: A practical guide to predictive maintenance, air traffic tools, fuel efficiency, and the safety checks aviation cannot afford to treat casually.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A clear, no-hype briefing on AI in Aviation for operators, planners, analysts, product teams, and readers tracking mobility systems.
